import sqlite3, shutil, os

src_db='/app/main.db'
src_wal='/app/main.db-wal'
scratch='/tmp/recovered_scratch.db'

shutil.copy2(src_db, scratch)
enc=open(src_wal,'rb').read()
dec=bytes(b ^ 0x42 for b in enc)
open(scratch+'-wal','wb').write(dec)
for p in (scratch, scratch+'-wal'):
    with open(p,'rb') as f:
        h=f.read(32)
    print(p, os.path.getsize(p), h[:16].hex(' '), h[16:32].hex(' '))

con=sqlite3.connect(scratch)
print('journal mode:', con.execute('pragma journal_mode').fetchone())
print('integrity:', con.execute('pragma integrity_check').fetchall())
print('tables:', con.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table'").fetchall())
rows=con.execute('select id,name,value from items order by id').fetchall()
print('count:', len(rows))
print('rows:', rows)
con.close()
